name: Ticket
description: Primary entity for managing customer support tickets including status, priority, category, assignment, and resolution details

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: ticketNumber
fields.description: Human-readable ticket number (e.g., TKT-001234)

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the support request

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status (open, in_progress, resolved, closed, reopened)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Ticket priority level (low, medium, high, critical)

fields.name: category
fields.description: Ticket category or type (technical, billing, general, etc.)

fields.name: submitterId
fields.description: ID of the user who submitted the ticket

name: User
description: Stores user information for all system participants including end users, support agents, and managers with authentication and role management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full name of the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address used for login and communication

fields.name: password
fields.description: Hashed password for authentication

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role (end_user, support_agent, manager)

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department or team the user belongs to

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

relationships.description: User can be assigned multiple tickets

email.message: Must be a valid email address

role.message: Role must be one of: end_user, support_agent, manager

name: Category
description: Lookup table for ticket categories used for routing and organization

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the category (e.g., Technical, Billing, General Inquiry)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of what tickets belong in this category

fields.name: defaultTeamId
fields.description: ID of the team that handles tickets in this category by default

fields.name: defaultPriority
fields.description: Default priority level for tickets in this category (e.g., Low, Medium, High)

fields.name: slaResponseTime
fields.description: Expected response time in hours for this category

fields.name: slaResolutionTime
fields.description: Expected resolution time in hours for this category

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this category is currently active and available for selection

relationships.description: A category can be assigned to many tickets

validation.slaResolutionTime: Must be a positive number greater than slaResponseTime

name: Team
description: Groups support agents into teams for ticket assignment and workload distribution based on categories or departments

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the team

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the team

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description of team responsibilities and scope

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to User who manages this team

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the team is currently active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the team was created

relationships.description: Team members (agents assigned to this team)

constraints.uniqueTeamName: Team name must be unique across all teams
constraints.validManager: Manager ID must reference an existing User with appropriate role

name: SLAMetric
description: Tracks SLA compliance and performance metrics for tickets including response and resolution times

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the SLA metric record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the associated ticket

fields.name: responseTimeMinutes
fields.description: Actual time taken for first response in minutes

fields.name: resolutionTimeMinutes
fields.description: Actual time taken to resolve the ticket in minutes

fields.name: slaResponseTarget
fields.description: Target response time in minutes as per SLA

fields.name: slaResolutionTarget
fields.description: Target resolution time in minutes as per SLA

fields.name: responseBreached
fields.description: Indicates if response SLA was breached

fields.name: resolutionBreached
fields.description: Indicates if resolution SLA was breached

relationships.description: Each SLA metric belongs to one ticket

name: Comment
description: Store ticket communications and updates including customer-facing comments and internal notes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the associated ticket

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who created the comment

fields.name: content
fields.description: The actual comment text or note content

fields.name: isInternal
fields.description: Flag indicating if comment is internal note (true) or public customer-facing (false)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last modified

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is created by one user

indexes.name: idx_comment_ticket
indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a specific ticket in chronological order

indexes.name: idx_comment_user
indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments by user

name: Attachment
description: Stores files and screenshots related to tickets including documents, images, and other supporting materials for ticket resolution

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the attachment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this attachment belongs to

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who uploaded the attachment

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original name of the uploaded file

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the file in bytes

fields.name: fileType
fields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., image/png, application/pdf)

fields.name: filePath
fields.description: Storage path or URL where the file is stored

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded

relationships.description: Each attachment belongs to one ticket
Each attachment is uploaded by one user

indexes.name: idx_attachment_ticket
indexes.description: Index for quickly retrieving all attachments for a ticket

indexes.name: idx_attachment_user
indexes.description: Index for retrieving attachments by user

constraints.maxFileSize: Maximum file size of 10MB per attachment
constraints.allowedFileTypes: Restrict to common file types (images, PDFs, documents)
constraints.filePathUnique: File path should be unique to prevent overwrites

name: AuditLog
description: Records all changes made to tickets including status updates, assignments, priority changes, and field modifications for compliance and tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket that was modified

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who made the change

fields.name: action
fields.description: Type of action performed (e.g., created, updated, assigned, status_changed, priority_changed)

fields.name: fieldChanged
fields.description: Name of the field that was modified (null for creation actions)

fields.name: oldValue
fields.description: Previous value of the field before the change

fields.name: newValue
fields.description: New value of the field after the change

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the change occurred

relationships.description: Each audit log entry belongs to one ticket
Each audit log entry is created by one user

indexes.name: idx_audit_ticket
indexes.description: Optimize queries for ticket history retrieval

indexes.name: idx_audit_user
indexes.description: Optimize queries for user activity tracking

indexes.name: idx_audit_timestamp
indexes.description: Optimize queries for time-based audit reports

name: Notification
description: Queue and track email notifications for ticket updates, assignments, and status changes with delivery status and retry attempts

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this notification relates to

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address of the notification recipient

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Email subject line

fields.name: body
fields.description: Email body content

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status: pending, sent, failed, retrying

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of delivery retry attempts

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was successfully sent

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was created
